posts.text: [Image] Two photographed pages from The Epoch Times Opinion section show an article titled “Iran Is Not Even Close to Winning the War,” by Mike Fredenburg. The first page features a large cityscape with smoke rising over Tehran, captioned as smoke from airstrikes on March 6, 2026. The continuation discusses Iran’s military, economic, and regional setbacks and U.S. strategy.

posts.title: The White House was in very bad condition, both inside and out. Frankly, it was a “dump!” Past Presidents did not take care of it. I love renovating it during my spare time, which is not much. The Department of Interior, and various contractors, are doing a fantastic job. Attached are pictures of BEFORE and AFTER. The exterior “skin” of the Building was practically falling off! It is now in better shape than when built in 1792. Such an Honor to have the privilege of saving this Great Structure! More time without renovation would have destroyed our beloved White House! President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.text:
The White House was in very bad condition, both inside and out. Frankly, it was a “dump!” Past Presidents did not take care of it. I love renovating it during my spare time, which is not much. The Department of Interior, and various contractors, are doing a fantastic job. Attached are pictures of BEFORE and AFTER. The exterior “skin” of the Building was practically falling off! It is now in better shape than when built in 1792. Such an Honor to have the privilege of saving this Great Structure! More time without renovation would have destroyed our beloved White House! President DONALD J. TRUMP

[Image] A three-image collage shows restoration work on large white architectural columns outside and inside a classical building. The first image compares a rough, textured column base labeled “BEFORE” with a smooth painted surface labeled “AFTER.” A uniformed security officer stands nearby, while tools, buckets, protective flooring, and steps are visible. The final image shows a tall column surrounded by scaffolding.
